title: A team's style is a fingerprint
subtitle: Half a season of how a team moves the ball picks out its other half from the whole league
note: Flow graph of 30 pitch zones per team, fitted on alternate matches; the other half matched by distance. Chance = 1 / number of teams.
caption:
Give me half of a team's season and I can tell you which team it is.

I turned every team into a graph of how the ball moves between pitch zones. Fitted on one half of their matches, it picks out the same team from the other half 90-95% of the time in the 2015/16 Premier League and Serie A (chance: 5%).

Style isn't vibes. It's a fingerprint.
